text: SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id, m.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON cr.molregno = m.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.chembl_id ASC, m.pref_name ASC, cs.canonical_smiles ASC;
